review_policy: Every entry carries review_date. Entries past review_date are stale and must be re-verified before use, not silently trusted.

rules.applies_when: Unsupervised teaching or training of under-18s.
rules.citation: SVGA 2006 Sch 4 Pt 1; exact wording to confirm against DBS eligibility guidance
rules.detail: Enhanced DBS + Children's Barred List for unsupervised teaching/training of under-18s.
rules.escalation: Confirm DBS eligibility before any unsupervised contact with minors.
rules.failure_mode: Unsafeguarded contact with minors; business-ending incident.
rules.law: Regulated activity with children (teaching/training unsupervised)
rules.owner_action: Check DBS eligibility; obtain enhanced checks where required.

rules.applies_when: Any gas installation, service, or maintenance work.
rules.citation: Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998, reg 3; HSE ACOP L56
rules.detail: No gas work unless competent; no employee/self-employed gas work unless in HSE-approved class (Gas Safe Register). Employers must ensure and monitor competence.
rules.escalation: Stop the job; refer to a Gas Safe registered engineer.
rules.failure_mode: Criminal offence; invalidates insurance; employer liable.
rules.law: Gas competence + Gas Safe Register membership
rules.owner_action: Verify Gas Safe registration before quoting or dispatching gas work.

rules.applies_when: Installing, servicing, maintaining, leak-checking, recovering, or decommissioning refrigeration, AC, or heat-pump equipment containing F-gases.
rules.citation: Reg 2015/2067 (retained UK law); Fluorinated Greenhouse Gases Regulations 2015
rules.detail: Certificate required for F-gas work on stationary refrigeration, air conditioning, heat pumps, and refrigerated trucks/trailers.
rules.escalation: Stop the job; refer to a certified handler.
rules.failure_mode: Criminal offence; failed F-Gas audit; fines.
rules.law: F-Gas qualification requirement
rules.owner_action: Verify F-gas certification before quoting or dispatching.

rules.applies_when: Construction work with principal-contractor or contractor roles.
rules.citation: Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015 (SI 2015/51), regs 12-15
rules.detail: Principal contractor plans, manages, and monitors; contractors SKET-check appointees; domestic-client duties default to the contractor in control.
rules.escalation: Pause site work until duties are assigned in writing.
rules.failure_mode: Site shut down; directors liable; locked out of tenders.
rules.law: CDM principal-contractor + contractor duties
rules.owner_action: Assign CDM duties in writing before site work starts.

rules.applies_when: Paying subcontractors in construction.
rules.citation: Finance Act 2004 ss58-59; HMRC CISR manuals
rules.detail: Verify subcontractors with HMRC; deduct 20% registered / 30% unregistered; file CIS300 monthly.
rules.escalation: Paying at the wrong rate is the contractor's liability; correct immediately.
rules.failure_mode: CIS penalties; cash-flow shock from wrong deductions.
rules.law: Construction Industry Scheme deductions
rules.owner_action: Verify every new subcontractor with HMRC before first payment.

rules.applies_when: Selling prepacked-for-direct-sale food.
rules.citation: Food Information (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2019 (SI 2019/1218), in force 1 Oct 2021
rules.detail: Name plus full ingredients with 14 allergens emphasised, on package or label.
rules.escalation: Withdraw non-compliant products immediately.
rules.failure_mode: Allergic reaction without label trail; prosecution.
rules.law: Natasha's Law: PPDS allergen labelling
rules.owner_action: Label every PPDS item before sale.

rules.applies_when: Staff receive tips, gratuities, or service charges.
rules.citation: Employment (Allocation of Tips) Act 2023, in force 1 Oct 2024; ITEPA Reg 100
rules.detail: Allocate 100% of qualifying tips fairly with no deductions; written policy where non-occasional; independent tronc only if genuinely independent.
rules.escalation: Tribunal exposure; correct allocations and document the policy.
rules.failure_mode: Unlawful deductions + NIC errors; tribunal exposure.
rules.law: Fair tips: 100% pass-through + written policy + tronc rules
rules.owner_action: Write the tips policy; allocate fairly; keep records.

rules.applies_when: Sole trader or landlord above the qualifying-income threshold.
rules.citation: Finance (No.2) Act 2017; Income Tax (Digital Requirements) Regulations 2021
rules.detail: Digital records plus quarterly updates via compatible software: £50k+ from Apr 2026, £30k+ from Apr 2027, £20k+ from Apr 2028. Points accrue per missed deadline.
rules.escalation: Refer to accountant when thresholds or scope are unclear.
rules.failure_mode: HMRC penalties (points-based); client churn at mandate dates.
rules.law: MTD for Income Tax: digital records + quarterly updates
rules.owner_action: Use compatible MTD software before the applicable mandate date.

rules.applies_when: Providing accountancy services as a business.
rules.citation: Money Laundering Regulations 2017
rules.detail: Register with HMRC or a professional-body supervisor unless exempt (under £30k turnover, under 5% accountancy, supervised review).
rules.escalation: Stop supervised work until registered; unregistered practice is criminal.
rules.failure_mode: Unsupervised practice = criminal offence; firm shutdown.
rules.law: AML supervision for accountancy service providers
rules.owner_action: Confirm supervision is in place before taking bookkeeping clients.

rules.applies_when: Operating a funeral business in scope of the CMA order.
rules.citation: CMA Funerals Market Investigation Order 2021 (Enterprise Act 2002)
rules.detail: Standardised Price List plus Attended/Unattended prices; ownership disclosure; ban on hospital/hospice/care-home inducements and coroner/police solicitation. No licensing regime in England/Wales yet.
rules.escalation: CMA enforcement; never claim regulated status.
rules.failure_mode: CMA enforcement; reputational damage in a trust market.
rules.law: Funeral price transparency + inducement ban
rules.owner_action: Publish required price lists and ownership disclosure.

rules.applies_when: Tree work near protected trees or conservation areas.
rules.citation: Town and Country Planning Act 1990; TPO Regulations 2012
rules.detail: Check TPO/register status before quoting; correct notice or application per route; diary the statutory response window per case. Never hardcode one clock.
rules.escalation: Illegal fell risks prosecution, unlimited fine, replanting orders.
rules.failure_mode: Illegal fell: prosecution, unlimited fine, replanting orders.
rules.law: Tree Preservation Orders + conservation-area controls
rules.owner_action: Check protection status before quoting any tree work.

rules.applies_when: Climbing kit used for lifting persons; chainsaw work.
rules.citation: Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998; PUWER 1998
rules.detail: 6-monthly thorough examination for climbing kit used for lifting persons; documented chainsaw training (NPTC route) for insurance and council work. No statutory 'chainsaw licence' exists.
rules.escalation: Injury with lapsed inspection means the insurer walks away.
rules.failure_mode: Injury with lapsed inspection; insurer walks away.
rules.law: LOLER inspections + chainsaw competence
rules.owner_action: Keep inspection and training records current and auditable.

rules.applies_when: Any electrical installation, service, or maintenance work.
rules.citation: Electricity at Work Regulations 1989; Building Regulations 2010 Part P; Electrical Safety Standards (PRS England) Regulations 2020
rules.detail: Competent persons only; notifiable domestic work via registered scheme or building control; private rentals need valid 5-year EICR.
rules.escalation: Injury liability; invalidated insurance; PRS prohibition on letting.
rules.failure_mode: Injury liability; invalidated insurance; PRS prohibition on letting.
rules.law: Electrical competence + Part P + PRS 5-yearly EICRs
rules.owner_action: Verify competence and scheme membership before quoting notifiable work.

rules.applies_when: Dispensing veterinary medicines or holding controlled drugs.
rules.citation: Veterinary Medicines Regulations 2013; Misuse of Drugs Regulations 2001; RCVS Practice Standards Scheme
rules.detail: Every dispense logged with batch and prescriber, 5-year retention; controlled-drug running balances with witnesses; PSS evidence pack always ready.
rules.escalation: Failed unannounced RCVS inspection; dispensing prosecution.
rules.failure_mode: Failed unannounced RCVS inspection; dispensing prosecution.
rules.law: VMR batch/prescriber/5yr retention + Schedule 2 CD register + PSS
rules.owner_action: Keep the CD register and PSS pack inspection-ready at all times.

rules.applies_when: Handling client personal data or card payments.
rules.citation: UK GDPR + Data Protection Act 2018; PCI DSS (contractual via acquirers)
rules.detail: Lawful basis and minimisation for client data and photos; never store raw PANs; secrets as references, never values.
rules.escalation: ICO fines; card-scheme withdrawal; breach-notification duties.
rules.failure_mode: ICO fines; card-scheme withdrawal; breach-notification duties.
rules.law: Data protection + card-data handling
rules.owner_action: Record lawful basis; minimise data; keep card data with the acquirer.

rules.applies_when: Driving for hire or reward.
rules.citation: Road Traffic Act 1988 s.143; AMAP rates
rules.detail: Hire-and-reward cover required (standard SDP excludes paid work); log all miles for AMAP (55p/mile to 10k from Apr 2026).
rules.escalation: Uninsured driving is criminal; log miles or lose deductions.
rules.failure_mode: Uninsured driving (criminal); deactivation; SA underclaim.
rules.law: Hire-and-reward insurance + mileage rules
rules.owner_action: Confirm hire-and-reward cover; log every mile.

rules.applies_when: Boarding, daycare, or breeding animals.
rules.citation: Animal Welfare Act 2006; Animal Welfare (Licensing of Activities Involving Animals) (England) Regulations 2018
rules.detail: Local-authority licence required; 5-star rating criteria as ops checklist; incident protocol in place.
rules.escalation: Unlicensed operation prosecution; incident without protocol.
rules.failure_mode: Unlicensed boarding/daycare prosecution; incident without protocol.
rules.law: Boarding/daycare licensing + welfare duty
rules.owner_action: Confirm licence status with the local authority before trading.

rules.applies_when: Operating hotels, venues, garages, or food premises.
rules.citation: Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005; DVSA MOT standards; Food Safety and Hygiene (England) Regulations 2013
rules.detail: Fire risk assessment with competent persons; honest MOT testing per DVSA standards; FHRS hygiene discipline.
rules.escalation: Prohibition notices; invalid MOTs; hygiene ratings collapse.
rules.failure_mode: Prohibition notices; invalid MOTs; hygiene ratings collapse.
rules.law: Fire safety + MOT integrity + food hygiene baselines
rules.owner_action: Keep fire, MOT, and hygiene records inspection-ready.

rules.applies_when: Selling goods to consumers or trading past the allowance.
rules.citation: Consumer Rights Act 2015; Consumer Contracts Regs 2013
rules.detail: Goods must be fit for purpose; 14-day distance-returns information; register with HMRC past £1,000 trading income.
rules.escalation: Chargebacks and returns spiral; unregistered trading.
rules.failure_mode: Chargebacks + returns spiral; trading past allowance unregistered.
rules.law: Consumer rights + distance selling + trading allowance
rules.owner_action: Publish returns information; register past £1k trading income.

rules.applies_when: Clinical decisions supported by machine triage.
rules.citation: GMC Good Medical Practice; duty of candour (HSCA Reg 20)
rules.detail: Agent handles admin and navigation only; every clinical decision traceable to a registered clinician; open disclosure on harm.
rules.escalation: Wrong decision on machine-triaged case; fragmented record.
rules.failure_mode: Clinician decides wrongly on machine-triaged case; record fragmented.
rules.law: Clinical judgment stays with registered clinicians; duty of candour on harm
rules.owner_action: Restrict agent to admin; route every clinical decision to a clinician.

rules.applies_when: Using tints, bleach, or salon chemicals.
rules.citation: COSHH Regulations 2002 (salon chemicals); industry patch-test duty of care
rules.detail: COSHH assessments for tints and bleach; patch test plus record before colour services.
rules.escalation: Reaction without patch-test record; HSE notice.
rules.failure_mode: Reaction without patch-test record; HSE notice.
rules.law: Chemical safety + patch-test records in hair/beauty
rules.owner_action: Record patch-test date and result before every colour service.

rules.applies_when: Using cleaning chemicals or working at height.
rules.citation: Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations 2002; Work at Height Regulations 2005
rules.detail: COSHH assessments for bleach, solvents, and detergents; risk assessment and controls for ladder and window work; competent persons only.
rules.escalation: Chemical injury without assessment; fall without controls.
rules.failure_mode: Chemical injury without assessment; fall from height without controls.
rules.law: COSHH + Work at Height for cleaning trades
rules.owner_action: Assess chemicals and heights before quoting the job.

rules.applies_when: Creating business social accounts.
rules.citation: Platform ToS (contract, not statute)
rules.detail: Social account creation is human-only. The agent maps, guides, verifies, and connects — it never creates accounts. Explicitly NOT law.
rules.escalation: Banned accounts; lost handles; no legal recourse.
rules.failure_mode: Banned accounts; lost handles; no legal recourse.
rules.law: Social account creation is human-only (PLATFORM RULE, not legislation)
rules.owner_action: Customer claims every handle personally.

rules.applies_when: Any spend, payment, or financial commitment.
rules.citation: OWASP agent-security guidance + kernel invariant (design rule, not statute)
rules.detail: Money moves only on human-issued, parameter-bound, single-use, expiring capability. Explicitly NOT statute.
rules.escalation: Unauthorised spend.
rules.failure_mode: Unauthorised spend.
rules.law: Money moves on human approval (DESIGN RULE, not legislation)
rules.owner_action: Approve each spend with exact amount and destination.

rules.applies_when: Registering taxable turnover.
rules.citation: VATA 1994; gov.uk VAT registration thresholds
rules.detail: Register at £90,000 taxable turnover over a rolling 12 months. MTD for VAT returns. Non-established UK suppliers can have different obligations.
rules.escalation: Late registration penalties; backdated VAT liability.
rules.failure_mode: Trading above threshold unregistered.
rules.law: VAT registration at £90,000 rolling turnover
rules.owner_action: Monitor rolling turnover monthly; register before breaching.

rules.applies_when: Operating through a limited company.
rules.citation: Corporation Tax Act 2009/2010
rules.detail: Corporation Tax on company profits; digital records for year end; main rate applies above thresholds with marginal relief below.
rules.escalation: Late filing penalties; incorrect relief claims.
rules.failure_mode: Late or incorrect company tax filing.
rules.law: Corporation Tax on company profits
rules.owner_action: Keep digital records; file via accountant or compatible software.

rules.applies_when: Employing staff.
rules.citation: ITEPA 2003 (PAYE); Social Security Contributions and Benefits Act 1992; Pensions Act 2008
rules.detail: Operate PAYE, deduct Income Tax and Class 1 NICs, auto-enrol eligible staff into pensions. National Minimum/Living Wage floors apply.
rules.escalation: HMRC payroll penalties; employment tribunal exposure.
rules.failure_mode: Non-compliant payroll; underpaid staff.
rules.law: PAYE, NICs, pensions, and wage floors for employers
rules.owner_action: Run payroll through compliant software or a bureau before each payday.

rules.applies_when: Reading bank transactions or initiating payments through software.
rules.citation: Payment Services Regulations 2017; FCA authorisation regime
rules.detail: Account-information and payment-initiation services are regulated activities. Use an appropriately authorised provider; never collect customer banking credentials.
rules.escalation: Unregulated payment activity; credential compromise.
rules.failure_mode: Unregulated payment activity; credential compromise.
rules.law: FCA authorisation for account and payment initiation
rules.owner_action: Use authorised providers only; keep banking credentials out of AI tooling.

rules.applies_when: Sending promotional emails, WhatsApp messages, or social DMs.
rules.citation: Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations 2003; ICO direct-marketing guidance
rules.detail: Sole traders and some partnerships are individual subscribers: unsolicited electronic marketing generally needs consent unless a valid soft opt-in applies. Screen live calls against TPS/CTPS.
rules.escalation: ICO enforcement; reputational damage.
rules.failure_mode: Unlawful marketing; ICO enforcement.
rules.law: PECR consent and soft opt-in for electronic marketing
rules.owner_action: Record channel-specific consent; screen TPS/CTPS; honour objections immediately.

rules.applies_when: Recording business calls.
rules.citation: UK GDPR; RIPA business exemption requires notification and lawful basis
rules.detail: Inform all parties that calls are recorded; state the purpose; store securely with retention limits. Confirm the exact position with legal advice before deploying.
rules.escalation: Unlawful interception claims; ICO complaints.
rules.failure_mode: Recorded calls without notification or basis.
rules.law: Call-recording notification and lawful basis (DESIGN GUIDANCE, not legislation)
rules.owner_action: Play a recording notice; document purpose and retention.

rules.applies_when: Storing or transmitting business or customer data.
rules.citation: OWASP agent-security guidance; kernel invariant
rules.detail: No secrets in prompts, logs, handovers, or backups metadata. Secrets live in customer-owned vaults or OS keychains, referenced never valued.
rules.escalation: Credential leak; cross-customer exposure.
rules.failure_mode: Secrets in prompts, logs, or handovers.
rules.law: Secrets handling (DESIGN RULE, not legislation)
rules.owner_action: Scan every generated artifact for secret patterns before delivery.

rules.applies_when: Serving more than one customer from shared infrastructure.
rules.citation: Kernel invariant: tenant-scoped queries and disjoint storage
rules.detail: Every row acted on must belong to the expected customer. Cross-tenant reads or writes fail closed.
rules.escalation: Cross-customer data exposure.
rules.failure_mode: Cross-customer data exposure.
rules.law: Tenant isolation (DESIGN RULE, not legislation)
rules.owner_action: Enforce tenant checks on every result set before acting.

rules.applies_when: Letting an AI assistant act for a UK business.
rules.citation: Meta announcement 8 Sep 2026; Muse Connector Platform review process
rules.detail: Muse is US-only with no confirmed UK date. Connectors need functional, security, and legal review. Custom connectors are unreviewed. Never promise directory placement.
rules.escalation: Selling access that does not exist.
rules.failure_mode: Selling Muse access or integrations that do not exist.
rules.law: Muse availability and connector review (PLATFORM REALITY, not legislation)
rules.owner_action: Sell assistant-agnostic workflows; track Muse eligibility per customer.

rules.applies_when: Connecting ChatGPT to customer systems.
rules.citation: OpenAI MCP and plugin documentation; ChatGPT Learn MCP docs
rules.detail: MCP is real but gated: Developer Mode plus paid plan, remote HTTPS endpoints only, per-action confirmation. Old 2023 plugins are deprecated. Availability varies by plan, region, workspace, and role.
rules.escalation: Selling ChatGPT access the customer cannot enable.
rules.failure_mode: Selling ChatGPT integrations the customer cannot enable.
rules.law: ChatGPT MCP gating (PLATFORM REALITY, not legislation)
rules.owner_action: Verify plan, region, workspace policy, and endpoint reachability first.

rules.law: Regulated activity with adults + DBS barred-list checks
rules.detail: Enhanced DBS + Adults' Barred List for personal care, healthcare under direction/supervision, social work, day-to-day management of those doing it; Regulated Activity Providers have a legal duty to refer
rules.citation: Safeguarding Vulnerable Groups Act 2006 (amended PoFA 2012); gov.uk DBS guidance
rules.failure_mode: Barred person employed; RAP fails in duty to refer; CQC questions fitness
rules.applies_when: Operating in the regulated activity described.
rules.owner_action: Confirm registration, checks, and standards before trading.
rules.escalation: Enforcement and referral loss.

rules.law: CQC fundamental standards + fit and proper persons
rules.detail: Reg 19: robust recruitment, relevant checks, ongoing fitness monitoring; Regs 9-20A: person-centred care, consent, safe care, safeguarding, staffing, governance, duty of candour
rules.citation: Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014 (SI 2014/2936), Regs 9-20A
rules.failure_mode: Refused registration; enforcement; rating drop kills referrals
rules.applies_when: Operating in the regulated activity described.
rules.owner_action: Confirm registration, checks, and standards before trading.
rules.escalation: Enforcement and referral loss.
